entries.text: The Linux machine used by make ci-linux and the pr-preflight Linux step is now stopped after every guarded run unless BENCHBOX_KEEP_LINUX_MACHINE=1 is set or another container machine run, create or linux_machine_run.sh process is using it. The heavy-work sentinel also stops it when it is running, no such process has been seen for BENCHBOX_HEAVY_VM_IDLE_MINUTES (default 10) and no live lock holder's tree contains the wrapper or a container machine run for it; BENCHBOX_HEAVY_LINUX_MACHINE names the machine. make heavy-status flags a running VM with no lock holder and any UNGUARDED VM RUN.
